text:
anya: heads-up: three deprecations land next month (auth-v1 removal, streaming-frame shape tweak, embeddings dim bump). worried about combinatorial client impact. propose a short grace window accepting old+new with a compat mesh header + combined telemetry.
matt: sounds right. suggest header `X-RW-Compat-Mesh: true` so proxies/SDKs can opt in to translation.
sanjay: +1 but note streaming-frame translation is lossy. prefer server-side fallback policy per-tenant: keep old codepath behind flag for 30-60 days.
anya: rollout plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 100%. we need console visibility and billing invariants.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary starts 2026-04-05T02:00Z. auto-rollback if 5xx spike >0.5%.
jen: SDKs should ship adapters that honor the header and normalize frames; reduces runtime load.
kevin: many customers won't update quickly. runtime telemetry must segment by client version + compat header + route.
anya: decision proposal: 1) support compat header; 2) runtime translates when header=true for 60 days; 3) emit telemetry flags compat_mesh and translated; 4) Console shows progress; 5) after 60d drop translation.
matt: need per-tenant feature flag and ensure quota/rate accounting stable when translating to avoid billing surprises.
sanjay: also ensure KV cache keys include model_version and compat_tag to avoid cache poisoning.
docs-bot: docs task: add compat-mesh header reference + node/python examples + migration checklist.
anya: sample headers: `X-RW-Compat-Mesh: true`, `X-RW-Compat-Mesh-Mode: permissive` (permissive|strict).
matt: permissive = rewrite old->new silently; strict = reject old with 422 and migration hints.
jen: propose temporary mesh-debug cookie for canary tenants returning conversion logs for easier debugging.
kevin: telemetry schema: compat.mesh.enabled (bool), compat.mesh.mode (string), compat.translated (bool), compat.client_version (string). send to infra for BI piping.
anya: next: write RFC follow-up with these decisions, infra to add tenant flag + rollback hook, SDKs to release adapter, docs to publish. scheduling RFC PR for Monday. thanks :raised_hands:
infra-bot: canary rollout acknowledged. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/compat-mesh/5070010000
